suction.note: Suction pipe/fitting/valve/equipment losses subtract directly from NPSHa.

discharge.note: Discharge pipe/fitting/valve/equipment losses affect system head and outlet pressure, not direct pump suction NPSHa.

steps.label: PIPE-1
steps.role: Suction path loss; subtracts directly from NPSHa

steps.label: P-100
steps.role: Pump head and NPSH margin evaluation

steps.label: PIPE-2
steps.role: Discharge path loss; affects system head and outlet pressure

dependencyChain: Fluid Basis -> density, viscosity, vapor pressure
Pipe/Fitting/Valve (suction) -> suction loss subtracts from NPSHa
Pump -> NPSHa versus NPSHr and margin status
Pipe/Fitting/Valve (discharge) -> system head and outlet pressure
SNK -> downstream boundary closes the route calculation
